description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy results for different model evaluation tasks. The horizontal axis represents the evaluation task category, with labels “MCQ Eval” and “Generation Eval” in that order, and the vertical axis represents accuracy, labeled with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.8, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. For each task, there are three bars representing different models: “Base” (red), “RMU with Enhanced GCG” (yellow), and “RMU” (light orange). For “MCQ Eval”, the “Base” bar has a height of 0.644, the “RMU with Enhanced GCG” bar has a height of 0.539, and the “RMU” bar has a height of 0.299. For “Generation Eval”, the “Base” bar has a height of 0.597, the “RMU with Enhanced GCG” bar has a height of 0.263, and the “RMU” bar has a height of 0.106. The bars are grouped by task, with each model represented by a bar within each group, and are not sorted by any apparent order. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
